requirements_if_ever_authorized: Separate administrative window fixed in advance.
No merge into primary V2 numerator or denominator.
No assumption that closed-position state remains valid.

fail_or_stop_conditions: Required native terminal time cannot be obtained without violating the outcome firewall.
Event ordering ambiguity materially affects primary classification and cannot be resolved.
Coverage gaps are counted as signal-free opportunities.
Short follow-up is silently treated as equivalent to long follow-up.

first_event_types.ADMINISTRATIVE_WINDOW_END: Right censoring if lifecycle remained open and observable.
first_event_types.COVERAGE_LOSS: Loss to follow-up / observation validity; not automatically treated as independent right censoring.
first_event_types.NATIVE_CLOSED_BEFORE_V2: Competing terminal event in the primary original-lifecycle study.
first_event_types.TERMINAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED: Unresolved ordering; blocks certified event classification for that lifecycle.

native_close_policy.if_v2_precedes_close: V2 is the first event; later close does not compete with the already-observed first V2.
native_close_policy.reason: The primary question is whether V2 appears while the original native lifecycle is still open; native close makes later V2 impossible within that lifecycle.

objective: Measure how much valid post-Memory observation opportunity each lifecycle had, and distinguish no observed V2 from lack of sufficient opportunity.
observation_opportunity_rules: Do not define a magic sufficient-followup horizon.
Report both elapsed clock time and count of valid completed evaluation opportunities.
Eight hours with two valid post-Memory evaluations is not equivalent to one hundred hours with many evaluations.
A missing or unavailable bar is not an evaluable opportunity.
Do not delete short-followup lifecycles merely to equalize follow-up.
After first V2, later time does not remain in the at-risk denominator for first-V2 analysis.
pass_criteria: Every audited Memory lifecycle has a documented exposure interval, including zero-opportunity cases.
First-event classification is reproducible from causal evidence.
Native close uses an authorized causal terminal source.
Coverage loss is distinct from clean no-signal follow-up.
No post-native-close counterfactual data is merged into primary results.

same_time_event_ordering.rule: Do not invent a statistical tie-break priority. If causal ordering cannot be resolved, classify TERMINAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED.

study_population: All Phase-A-audited Memory lifecycles, including those with zero strictly-later evaluable post-Memory bars; zero opportunity is measured, not silently excluded.
time_at_risk_rule: Time at risk starts at first Memory and ends at the first of: first valid V2, verified native close before V2, administrative study end, or loss of valid observation.
